title: What If the Moon Vanished Tonight?
hook: At 9:00 tonight the Moon disappears. The first thing it takes is the tide.
summary: A what-if deep dive (demo excerpt: cold open + chapter one). We follow one night without the Moon on a real coastline: why tides exist, how much of them the Sun can keep going on its own, and the change to the monthly tide rhythm nobody would notice until the shore did.
